code_path_findings.finding: HIRAC1 is the sole call site to this oprop.f90 CNVFNV; it can pass a private mode and existing line-identity metadata.
Candidate-v3 RDLIN instrumentation populates UDM37_RDLIN_ID(4,I) from raw MOL(I) for each line block; this supports matching decoded molecule/isotope without repeating a TAPE3 census.
Ordinary baseline R3 term is added before the coupling branch. Patch leaves this block byte-identical.

Coupling is a separate SPPSP nonzero block; its loop contributes to R3, R2 and R1. The patch skips only the selected record’s coupling DO 20, before accumulation. SPPSP, line/profile/acceptance/order, other records, and panel/interpolation remain untouched.
R3-to-R2 interpolation and R3 overlap carry remain untouched; analysis must map physical frequency across panel VFT/DVR3.

known_unresolved: Patch has not been compiled or run; no claim it compiles or selects exactly three runtime records.
Baseline trace must show all three target records/coupling events; ON trace must show baseline event retention and targeted stage-2 update absence.
OFF full-spectrum mismatch stops and preserves; ON is descriptive only.
This intervention does not test finite-support adequacy, reference validity, all CO2 coupling, or physical accuracy.
noninterference_reasoning: With OFF, the selector is false and original accumulation statements execute in original order. This is only a source argument; only a fresh OFF run with all 45 ODdeflt files byte-identical to the saved baseline establishes the required gate.
